summary: All AC-01 through AC-08 have required observable Test Cases and evidence oracles. The two OPEN prior findings are directly closed: TC-03 plus EV-02 require an ordered counting lookup sentinel proving zero denied lookups and authorization before exactly one authorized scoped lookup, while TC-07 plus EV-04 require condition-by-condition before/after PostgreSQL-backed composition recreation for temporary denial, every capability/binding/policy mismatch, and expiry with durable identity. Security ordering, PostgreSQL reconstruction, concurrency, canonical implementation, accepted #75 integration, and zero provider-write claims are tied to observable counters/traces/reconstruction evidence rather than unsupported prose. The guide preserves the #76 boundary and introduces no execution, reconciliation, vendor-write, plugin, or final-M4-review behavior.
